notes.title: More Bug fixes
notes.notes:
More bugs have been found post Shores update. One of which creates a soft lock for the player.
This bug should now be fixed although I was unable to recreate it so can't say for sure.
If you were affected by this bug and as a result are stuck in a blue void falling take these steps to fix it. 

In the Registry editor:
HKEY_CURRENT_USER then SOFTWARE then Fiinrii then Eris and the fading kingdom. In there you have access to the game's saved data. If you delete the PlayerPosX and PlayerPosY values it should fix your save. Hope this helps.

notes.title: Eris and the fading kingdom The Shores Of Tir nAill update coming this Summer
notes.notes:
Coming later this year is the Eris and the fading kingdom Shores of Tir nAill FREE content update. This update is huge and filled to the brim with new content.

[u][b]WHATS NEW?[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 6 Brand new areas to explore
[*] 20 Brand new enemies 
[*] 14 New bosses to test your strength against
[*] New Music tracks
[/list]

This update doubles the amount of content in the game and it is all free. I hope you look forward to more adventures in the kingdom of Tir nAill when the update launches later this year on both the PC and Mobile versions of the game.
